title: MCP Hub Registry — composio-generated layer
description: Schema for config/mcp-hub/registry.composio.generated.json. This layer is overwritten by scripts/composio-registry-sync.ts. It contains only composio-toolkit-* servers and composio-* bundles, and must NOT contain a defaults block — defaults live in the core layer.

propertyNames.description: Every server in the composio-generated layer must start with composio-toolkit-.
Bundles in the composio-generated layer must be composio-all or start with composio-category-.
